description: This file defines the TouchZoom handler for the Leaflet map library, enabling pinch-zoom functionality on supported mobile browsers. It extends the Handler class, manages touch events, and integrates with the Map class to provide touch-based zoom interactions.

classes.name: TouchZoom
classes.description: A handler class extending Leaflet's Handler to add pinch zoom support on mobile browsers.

methods.name: addHooks
methods.description: Adds event listeners and visual cues for touch zoom.

methods.name: removeHooks
methods.description: Removes event listeners and visual cues for touch zoom.

methods.name: _onTouchStart
methods.description: Handles the start of a touch event, initializing pinch zoom parameters.

methods.name: _onTouchMove
methods.description: Handles touch move events to perform pinch zoom calculations and map updates.

methods.name: _onTouchEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a touch event, finalizing zoom and resetting view.
